name: Motion and titles
description: Use when adding titles, lower thirds or animated text to a video: motion only where it helps, readable and on screen long enough, consistent style, and nothing that covers a face or the point.
verification: Pass or fail comes only from the Editing Studio's checks on the rendered file (QUALITY_GATES); the skill adds no tool, approval or setting.

evals.ask: Add a lower third with my name
Make an animated title for the intro
Add a CSS animation to the spinner
